Brighter star motifs and softened bangs for a gentler, more polished presence.
Eyebrows and lashes lightened with gray and brown hues. Now cell-shaded irises help her eyes pop and match the AI2U signature NPC look.

The timer runs as long as you're playing the apartment level, and will pause when you hit pause/ESC, adjust your Settings, or exit the demo. It will resume once you unpause or relaunch the demo.
[u][b]Note:[/b] You can check your chat history with the catgirl by pressing C, but we recommend limiting your time reading past chats as the timer won't pause here.[/u]

To make the best use of this timed experience, we recommend you start playing the demo when you can give the catgirl your full attention. You can chat with her without limits as long as the demo is running, so be generous in communicating with her! Our only other recommendations for you are to use your words wisely as you explore her apartment.

No matter what endings you get, the demo will give you a small taste of what it's like to play AI2U once it's available for Early Access!
